code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    q = (n + 1) // 2
    best = None
    for top, left, anti in [(0, 0, False), (0, n-q, True), (n-q, 0, True), (n-q, n-q, False)]:
        diag = [(top+i, left+(q-1-i if anti else i)) for i in range(q)]
        for color in {grid[r][c] for r in range(top, n) for c in range(left, n) if grid[r][c] != 7}:
            pts = [(r,c) for r in range(n) for c in range(n) if grid[r][c] == color]
            coverage = sum(grid[r][c] == color for r,c in diag)
            height = max(r for r,c in pts)-min(r for r,c in pts)+1
            score = (coverage, height == q, -len(pts))
            if best is None or score > best[0]:
                best = (score, color, top, left, anti)
    _, color, top, left, anti = best
    out = [[7]*n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(q):
        out[top+i][left+(q-1-i if anti else i)] = color
    return out
'''
